newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan overnights firm on funds shortage.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan overnights firm on funds shortage.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates closed higher on Friday as a liquidity squeeze from the previous day persisted. Dealers said rates would remain firm on Saturday.
The overnight market traded at 19.90 to 20 percent throughout the day, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
He said banks had approached the State (central) Bank of Pakistan's discount window to borrow about 5.5 billion rupees at the end of the day.
Dealers said the overnight market had turned bullish after 9.371 billion rupees were sucked out in settlement of an auction of six-month bonds on Thursday. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
